data.body: Re-probe 03:17 UTC (20:17 PDT), after the old container `…-8093` was reaped at 03:11:04: the clone's sync resumed on its own. Reflog shows `merge 89e7285829 … (ort)` at 03:14:57 UTC, the first recovery merge since 02:50:42. State is now HEAD `5f5efa923f`, 10 ahead / 6 behind `origin/tickets` (`6c76a66ff7`): the union merge landed but the push has not yet won against a fast-moving origin (three lanes writing via local CLI plus the reconciler). Only one MCP container is running now. This supports hypothesis 1 (blue-green overlap livelock on the shared clone) and argues against a credential or network fault. Next probe in a few minutes: if `ahead` reaches 0 the incident self-resolves and the remaining work is prevention (AC6) plus the `env_id_mismatch`/`unsigned_env` findings; if it stays ahead across several recovery cycles the push-retry budget (5 cycles) is exhausted each time by origin movement, and the operator repair is still needed.
